lines.zh: 我贴着黑色的岩壁滑行，翅膀不出声。
lines.en: I glide along the black rock face, wings silent.

lines.zh: 两对薄翅一前一后，把我推过裂谷。
lines.en: Two pairs of thin wings push me across the ravine.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地就等于把命交出去。
lines.en: I do not land; landing means handing over my life.

lines.zh: 夜里的风认得我，替我抬着身子。
lines.en: The night wind knows me and holds me up.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞顶走，爪子只勾一下就松。
lines.en: I cross the cave roof, claws hooking once and letting go.

lines.zh: 飞过腐肉堆时，我压低了一点。
lines.en: Passing the heap of rotten flesh, I dip lower.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上追我，追不上。
lines.en: My shadow chases me on the wall and never catches up.

lines.zh: 这块天太敞，我绕着边缘飞。
lines.en: This sky is too open; I circle its edges.

lines.zh: 翅膀每扇一次，就撒下一点黑粉。
lines.en: Each wingbeat sheds a little black dust.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但拐弯很急。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I turn very sharply.

lines.zh: 我从上头看的路线，比地面短得多。
lines.en: The route I see from above is far shorter than yours.

lines.zh: 黑色染料就是我的翅膀磨下来的。
lines.en: The black dye is simply my wings wearing away.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，水纹替我藏了影子。
lines.en: I skim the water, and its ripples hide my shadow.

lines.zh: 风停了，我只能扑得很吃力。
lines.en: When the wind stops, every wingbeat costs me.

lines.zh: 我顺着气流滑进裂谷深处。
lines.en: I ride the draft down into the ravine.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: I pause in midair, wings still quivering.

lines.zh: 我挂在洞顶，翅收成两片黑叶。
lines.en: I hang from the cave roof, wings folded into black leaves.

lines.zh: 倒着看这片未知之地，反而清楚。
lines.en: Hanging upside down, this unknown land looks clearer.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉的味道含在嘴里，慢慢咽。
lines.en: I hold the taste of carrion in my mouth and swallow.

lines.zh: 发酵蛛眼在我胃里发热，很舒服。
lines.en: The fermented spider eye burns warm in my gut.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，直到有东西忘了抬头。
lines.en: I stay still until something forgets to look up.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，像四枚小黑钩。
lines.en: My claws are folded in like four small black hooks.

lines.zh: 这片天没有星星，我照样认路。
lines.en: This sky has no stars, and still I know the way.

lines.zh: 我在听地面上的脚步，很轻的那种。
lines.en: I listen for footsteps below, the very light ones.

lines.zh: 翅膀干了，我就用后腿梳一梳。
lines.en: When my wings dry, I comb them with my hind legs.

lines.zh: 三十九颗心的重量，挂在细梁上。
lines.en: Thirty-nine hearts of weight hang from a thin beam.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩到最小，风就推不动我。
lines.en: I shrink as small as I can and the wind cannot move me.

lines.zh: 夜里我和石头一个颜色，谁也看不见。
lines.en: At night I match the stone, and no one sees me.

lines.zh: 我在等那阵熟悉的气味再回来。
lines.en: I wait for that familiar smell to come back.

lines.zh: 倒挂久了，血都往翅膀里沉。
lines.en: Hanging so long, the blood sinks into my wings.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我的翅膀抖了一下。
lines.en: You raise a torch and my wings twitch once.

lines.zh: 我数你有几处没被甲护住。
lines.en: I count the places your armor leaves bare.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，那我们就算见过面。
lines.en: You looked up, so we have met now.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你火把的光还黑。
lines.en: My eyes are blacker than your torchlight.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我俯冲线上。
lines.en: You stand exactly on my dive line.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，眨眼会漏掉你的动作。
lines.en: I do not blink; blinking would lose your movement.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐肉味，只有汗。
lines.en: You carry no smell of carrion, only sweat.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我记住这一步了。
lines.en: You took one step back, and I have marked it.

lines.zh: 你这身黑，学得不像我。
lines.en: Your black clothing does not imitate me well.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我正算你头顶的高度。
lines.en: While you look at me, I measure the height above you.

lines.zh: 你砍到翅膜，我漏了一点风。
lines.en: You cut my wing membrane and I leak a little air.

lines.zh: 黑血滴下来，落在地上像染料。
lines.en: Black blood drips down and pools like dye.

lines.zh: 我疼得往上窜，撞了洞顶。
lines.en: The pain sends me upward into the cave roof.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在爪上，我抓不住了。
lines.en: The blade hits my claw, and I lose my grip.

lines.zh: 我的翅在抖，飞不稳了。
lines.en: My wings tremble and my flight goes uneven.

lines.zh: 你打中我的腹，那是最软的地方。
lines.en: You struck my abdomen, the softest part of me.

lines.zh: 我掉下去一段，又扇起来了。
lines.en: I drop a stretch, then beat my way back up.

lines.zh: 这伤要养很久，夜鹰长得慢。
lines.en: This will take long to heal; nightwings grow slowly.

lines.zh: 我记住你的味道了，很难闻。
lines.en: I have your smell now, and it is foul.

lines.zh: 再砍一下，我的翅就只剩骨架。
lines.en: One more cut and my wing is bare frame.

lines.zh: 腐肉可以，你的面包不行。
lines.en: Rotten flesh yes; your bread, no.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西太新鲜，我不吃。
lines.en: What you hold is too fresh; I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我闻到发酵的味道了，往这边扔。
lines.en: I smell fermentation; throw it this way.

lines.zh: 你以为举着食物我就会下来。
lines.en: You think holding food will bring me down.

lines.zh: 我不落地吃东西，这是规矩。
lines.en: I do not land to eat; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 那块肉在滴水，正合我意。
lines.en: That meat is dripping, which suits me exactly.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉放下，退开十步。
lines.en: Put the rotten flesh down and step back ten paces.

lines.zh: 未知维度的夜里，我不吃现成。
lines.en: In the Unknown's night, I take no free meals.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼比你的手有趣多了。
lines.en: A spider's eye is far more interesting than your hand.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我就当你是在喂我。
lines.en: Raise it higher and I will take it as feeding.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞到一块会动的黑布。
lines.en: You hit me like a moving sheet of black cloth.

lines.zh: 我的骨很轻，撞起来却像石头。
lines.en: My bones are light, yet they strike like stone.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的翅膀撞乱了。
lines.en: That knocked my wings out of their rhythm.

lines.zh: 你比我重，可你退得更远。
lines.en: You are heavier, yet you are the one who recoils farther.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你肩膀划了一道。
lines.en: My claws left a line across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，翅粉会进眼睛。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; wing dust will get in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我们撞完，你身上多了黑印。
lines.en: After we collide, you are marked with black.

lines.zh: 我在半空稳住了，你在地上没稳住。
lines.en: I steadied in the air; you did not steady on the ground.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，我闻到你颈上的血。
lines.en: This close, I smell the blood at your neck.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我的翅膜就要裂了。
lines.en: One more collision and my wing membrane will tear.

lines.zh: 我们在洞顶追着飞，快的先选。
lines.en: We chase across the cave roof; the faster one chooses.

lines.zh: 她飞得比我稳，翅尖几乎不抖。
lines.en: She flies steadier, wingtips barely trembling.

lines.zh: 我们把卵粘在最高的石缝里。
lines.en: We glue the eggs into the highest crack.

lines.zh: 两只夜鹰交错而过，就算定了。
lines.en: Two nightwings pass each other, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最大的一块腐肉。
lines.en: I saved the largest piece of carrion for her.

lines.zh: 我们不唱歌，只用翅膀打拍子。
lines.en: We do not sing; we keep time with our wings.

lines.zh: 她的黑比我的更深一点。
lines.en: Her black is a shade deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 靠太近会撞翅，我们隔着一段飞。
lines.en: Too close and our wings collide, so we keep a space.

lines.zh: 分开后各飞各的，谁也不等。
lines.en: Afterward we fly apart, and neither waits.

lines.zh: 洞里的小的，出生就会往下掉。
lines.en: The young in the cave fall the moment they are born.

lines.zh: 我用后腿抓住腐肉，飞着带走。
lines.en: I grip the carrion with my hind legs and carry it off.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的染料，我以为是自己的粉。
lines.en: Dye on the ground I mistake for my own dust.

lines.zh: 太重的东西会把我拽下来。
lines.en: Anything too heavy drags me down.

lines.zh: 我捡起蛛眼，藏进颊边的囊里。
lines.en: I pick up the spider eye and tuck it in a cheek pouch.

lines.zh: 你掉的黑色布料，我拿来垫窝。
lines.en: The black cloth you dropped will line my nest.

lines.zh: 我不捡发亮的东西，那会招来别的。
lines.en: I do not pick up shiny things; they draw others.

lines.zh: 爪子只勾得住一条，多了会掉。
lines.en: My claws hold one thing; a second will fall.

lines.zh: 我抓起来又松开，只是试重量。
lines.en: I grab and release, only testing the weight.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉是我的，别伸手。
lines.en: This carrion is mine; keep your hands away.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西飞不高，很危险。
lines.en: Carrying something, I cannot fly high, which is dangerous.

lines.zh: 你踩碎一块石头，我就从梁上醒了。
lines.en: You crush a stone, and I wake on the beam.

lines.zh: 你在下面走，热气一直往上冒。
lines.en: You walk below, and your heat keeps rising.

lines.zh: 这么敞的地方，你居然不抬头。
lines.en: In a place this open, you still do not look up.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，量了量你到我的距离。
lines.en: I spread my wings and measure the distance to you.

lines.zh: 你身上有活物的味道，很浓。
lines.en: You carry the smell of something alive, strongly.

lines.zh: 我从岩顶收起翅膀，准备俯冲。
lines.en: I fold my wings on the crag and prepare to dive.

lines.zh: 这里的顶上，只有我一个。
lines.en: On this ceiling there is only me.

lines.zh: 你走进我的俯冲线，自己走进来的。
lines.en: You walked into my dive line on your own.

lines.zh: 这一击十点半，够你受的。
lines.en: Ten and a half points will be enough for you.

lines.zh: 我在你后颈上方停了半息。
lines.en: I hover half a breath above your neck.

lines.zh: 你没看见我，这就好办。
lines.en: You have not seen me, which makes this easy.

lines.zh: 阴影落到你脚边，那就是我。
lines.en: When a shadow reaches your feet, that is me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，越转越低。
lines.en: I circle you, dropping lower with each turn.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我就换你另一边。
lines.en: You raise a hand to block, so I switch sides.

lines.zh: 我等你的火把往下放。
lines.en: I wait for your torch to lower.

lines.zh: 你每次抬头，我都刚好在死角。
lines.en: Each time you look up, I am just out of sight.

lines.zh: 翅膜压着风，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My wing membrane presses the air with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 你数我的圈数，数到第三就乱了。
lines.en: You count my circles and lose it at the third.

lines.zh: 我挂在暗处等，你总会累。
lines.en: I wait in the dark; you will tire eventually.

lines.zh: 你在洞口，我在洞口上面。
lines.en: You are at the cave mouth; I am above it.

lines.zh: 你脸上先暗了一下，那是我。
lines.en: Your face darkened for an instant, and that was me.

lines.zh: 你退向亮处，我退向暗处。
lines.en: You retreat toward the light; I retreat toward the dark.

lines.zh: 再走两步，你就到崖边了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you reach the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，让你以为我走了。
lines.en: I hold still so you will think I have gone.

lines.zh: 我从上面砸下来，爪子先到。
lines.en: I drop from above, claws first.

lines.zh: 这一击十点五，骨头该响了。
lines.en: Ten and a half points; the bone should sound now.

lines.zh: 我的爪子钩进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My claws hook into the seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 我掠过你头顶，带走一小块皮。
lines.en: I sweep past your head and take a strip of skin.

lines.zh: 俯冲一次就要拉起来，我很费劲。
lines.en: After each dive I must climb again, and it costs me.

lines.zh: 你倒下了，我的翅膀还在扇。
lines.en: You fall, and my wings keep beating.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我用整具身体撞你。
lines.en: I do not bite; I strike you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 翅粉撒进你眼睛，然后我才下手。
lines.en: Wing dust goes into your eyes, and then I strike.

lines.zh: 这一下没中，我撞在岩壁上。
lines.en: I miss and strike the rock wall instead.

lines.zh: 我抓着你往上提，你太重了。
lines.en: I grip you and pull upward, but you are too heavy.

lines.zh: 未知之地的裂缝张开，我爬出来。
lines.en: A crack in the unknown land opens and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 我先学会扇翅，才学会看东西。
lines.en: I learned to beat my wings before I learned to see.

lines.zh: 黑暗里有一团东西动了，那是我。
lines.en: Something in the dark moved, and it was me.

lines.zh: 我从腐肉堆上站起来，翅膀还湿。
lines.en: I rise from the carrion heap with wet wings.

lines.zh: 洞顶多了一只黑鸟，那就是我。
lines.en: There is one more black bird on the roof, and it is me.

lines.zh: 落地时我摔了一下，翅折了个角。
lines.en: Landing, I fall once and fold a corner of my wing.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，我一闻就认得。
lines.en: One sniff and I know the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，只有翅粉落下。
lines.en: I was born without sound, only wing dust falling.

lines.zh: 空气很薄，我扇了好久才起来。
lines.en: The air is thin, and I beat a long time to rise.

lines.zh: 我睁眼第一件事，是找最高的地方。
lines.en: The first thing I do is look for the highest place.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的翅膜卷了起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我从梁上掉下去，翅来不及张。
lines.en: I drop from the beam before my wings open.

lines.zh: 水面盖过翅膀，我扇不动了。
lines.en: Water closes over my wings and they cannot beat.

lines.zh: 气浪把我拍在墙上，粉撒了一身。
lines.en: The blast slams me into the wall, dust everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膜，留下一个漏风的洞。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my wing and leaves a leaking hole.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我从空中掉了下来。
lines.en: The potion's smell drops me out of the air.

lines.zh: 胃里空得发响，我只能啃旧的皮。
lines.en: My gut rings empty; I can only gnaw old hide.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我全身的黑都反了白。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and all my black turns white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我的翅膀一点用都没有。
lines.en: No wind in the void; my wings are useless.
